Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.2.1: Prohibitions in Islam: Evils of Begging

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Prohibitions in Islam: Evils of Begging
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do people beg?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify categories of people who deserve assistance in society
2. describe the evils of begging as a means of fostering hard work
3. appreciate work as a means of eradicating poverty
